title: Plasma Physics
text: Plasma is the fourth state of matter, consisting of a hot ionized gas with roughly equal numbers of positively charged ions and negatively charged electrons. It is the most abundant form of visible matter in the universe, making up the Sun, other stars, and most of the interstellar medium. On Earth, plasma occurs naturally in lightning and the aurora borealis. Artificial plasmas are created in neon signs, plasma TVs, and fusion reactors. Plasma physics studies the behavior of plasmas, which respond strongly to electromagnetic fields and exhibit complex collective phenomena such as plasma waves and instabilities. Nuclear fusion in plasma is a promising clean energy source currently being researched worldwide.
